name: scroll-index
title: Scroll Index
description: A self-scrolling article paired with a vertical rail of ticks, one per heading. The rail marks passed and current sections, names them on hover, and can be dragged or clicked to jump through the text.
use: A long article lives in a fixed-height panel and readers need to see where they are and jump between headings.
avoid: It measures real headings, so late-loading or animating content can leave ticks misplaced until a resize.
a11y: The article region and ticks are focusable, labelled, arrow-key navigable, and reduced motion skips the smooth jump. (keyboard: yes, labels: good, reduced motion: respected)
looks: A dark rounded card holds a white-on-black article with headings and grey paragraphs. Down its right edge runs a short vertical rail of thin horizontal ticks of varying width, a moving progress mark, and an occasional small pill naming a section.
behaves: Scrolling the article moves a marker along the rail and recolours ticks as they are passed. Hovering the rail swells nearby ticks and shows the section name; dragging scrubs the article, then settles on the nearest heading.
customise: Pass the article as children plus a heading selector, self or window scrolling and a class name; tick size, rail height, snap distance and flash timing are constants in the source.
weight: moderate: Pointer tracking, resize observing and a requestAnimationFrame loop while ticks settle.
